intro: One selfie, one rap verse, two 'make my photo rap' tools. Which one lip-syncs better?

a: One photo, Rap tool, now your selfie spitting bars
Five free a day, I'm the people's pick, not just the stars
Eight thousand templates, motion on demand
You got one effect, I got the whole band
b: Rap God on the label, one tap and it's viral
Genjutsu face-swap, send your feed in a spiral
Rap Flex on the camera, that movement is mine
You bring the templates, I bring the cinema shine

rounds.title: Make this selfie rap
rounds.prompt: Photo-to-rap video, the person raps the verse to camera
rounds.inputs: Same front-facing photo (photo.jpg) and the same 15s rap audio (verse.mp3) in both tools. First render kept.
